about.title: About the Project
about.text: The Lagovsky Case is an independent information archive. The project aims to systematise public documents, court rulings, and media materials in order to ensure transparency in the legal process.
about.disclaimer: All published documents have been obtained from open sources or provided by the defence in the exercise of the right to public advocacy.

copyright.text: © 2025–2026 Lagovsky Case Archive. Information is updated as new court rulings become available.
